Name: BashBench (BashCoder-R1 2026)
Notes: NAME COLLISION with Redwood BashBench - different dataset. 952 tasks total, each with an LLM-generated + 100% manually-reviewed executable functional test suite. Only dataset found with an explicit single/multi split AND per-task tests. arXiv 2606.27733; data at zenodo.org/records/18408692 (1.1GB zip, CC-BY-4.0, data/evaluation/ + test_cases/). Also ships SFT set 12334 (7005 single + 5329 multi) and RL set 1824 (812 single + 1012 multi). Sources: StackOverflow, GitHub, man pages, Unix SE.

Name: BashBench (Redwood / Ctrl-Z 2025)
Notes: NAME COLLISION with BashCoder-R1 BashBench. 257 sysadmin tasks from Unix StackExchange, each solvable in up to 15 sequential bash commands, graded by public + private Python tests. Built for AI-control research. arXiv 2504.10374; bashcontrol.com

Name: Terminal-Bench 2.0
Notes: ICLR 2026, arXiv 2601.11868. Each task = NL instruction + Docker env + verification test suite + oracle solution. 16 categories. Run via the Harbor harness. github.com/harbor-framework/terminal-bench

Name: Terminal-Bench Pro (Alibaba)
Notes: huggingface.co/datasets/alibabagroup/terminal-bench-pro — harder Terminal-Bench variant; needs a cloud execution backend (e.g. Modal)

Name: Long-Horizon Terminal-Bench (LHTB)
Notes: 46 long-horizon tasks with HIDDEN verifiers; harness resumes the session with verifier feedback until pass or timeout. huggingface.co/datasets/IntelligenceLab/Long-Horizon-Terminal-Bench

Name: TerminalWorld
Notes: 1530 tasks reverse-engineered from public repos; each has NL instruction + oracle solution + state-based eval tests + reproducible Docker env. Also ships a 200-task human-`verified` subset. huggingface.co/datasets/EuniAI/TerminalWorld

Name: InterCode-Bash (IC-Bash)
Notes: NeurIPS 2023 arXiv 2306.14898. 200 tasks drawn from NL2Bash across 4 Docker filesystems; execution-based eval (git-diff of container state + MD5 of file contents + TF-IDF on stdout). FEH subset = 224 pairs. github.com/princeton-nlp/intercode

Name: laion/stackexchange-unix-sandboxes-verified
Notes: 10000 computer-use tasks from Unix & Linux StackExchange, each sandbox ships an LLM-judge verifier (verifiers/llm_judge.py, tests/test_state.py). Repackaged from DCAgent/stackexchange-unix-sandboxes-skywork-response. Verification is LLM-judged, not deterministic tests.

Name: nvidia/Nemotron-Terminal-Synthetic-Tasks
Notes: Synthetic terminal tasks with a per-task Verification Suite (tests/test.sh) + 9 standardized Docker images + sandboxed tmux. Companion to Nemotron-Terminal-Corpus. arXiv 2602.21193

Name: nvidia/Nemotron-Terminal-Corpus
Notes: 366154 execution trajectories in 4 configs (dataset_adapters 226313 / skill_based_easy 44809 / skill_based_medium 89343 / skill_based_mixed 5689). SFT trace corpus, not an NL->cmd pair set. arXiv 2602.21193. Re-uploaded verbatim by CathleenTico, txchmechanicus, nick007x (dupes).

Name: Eccentricity/bashbench2
Notes: 637 tasks, each with dockerfile + tests + setup script. Successor in spirit to the Redwood BashBench.

Name: Eccentricity/basharena2 (BashArena)
Notes: BashArena, arXiv 2512.15688 - control setting for highly privileged AI agents. 4684 task descriptions.

Name: tiararodney/posix-sdc
Notes: 4765 synthetic POSIX shell trajectories; 65% of reference solutions are multi-command. Has `checker`, `fixtures`, `verified`, `outcome` fields - every trajectory's outcome checked against real filesystem state. Single/multi split estimated from a 2975-row sample.

Name: saurabh5/rlvr-code-data-bash
Notes: STANDOUT FIND. 133247 rows, of which 66624 have a non-empty bash solution - and 100.0% of those are MULTI-LINE (function definitions, not one-liners), 66004 unique. Columns: translated_problem (NL) / translated_solution (bash) / translated_test_cases. Measured 0% overlap with NL2Bash, NL2CMD, NL2SH-ALFA, tldr - completely independent lineage. This is the largest multi-line-Bash-with-test-cases source found anywhere in the survey.

Name: AgentBench OS
Notes: ICLR 2024 arXiv 2308.03688. OS subset: agents act in a real Ubuntu Docker bash shell; ~1200 documented tasks with scripts + checking utilities (the released eval subset is much smaller). github.com/THUDM/AgentBench

Name: Local-LLMs-4-Bash (NDSS LASTX 2026)
Notes: KU Leuven. Corrected + extended InterCode-ALFA 300-task test set WITH realistic incorrect (negative) samples and an improved scoring scheme; fixed 18 mis-scored tasks and flagged 12 unverifiable ones. Also releases 2 RAG corpora: 981 environment man pages and 9812 NL2Bash reasoning examples. github.com/JefJacobs00/Local-LLMs-4-Bash

Name: b-mc2/cli-commands-explained
Notes: 16098 rows scraped from commandlinefu.com: real command + human title + human description + votes. Only 1-2% command overlap with NL2Bash/NL2SH-ALFA/NL2CMD/tldr, so it is GENUINELY INDEPENDENT - one of the few large sets that is not a re-mix. 15679 unique commands.

Name: ajibawa-2023/Shell-Code-Large
Notes: 639183 rows of real shell SCRIPTS from GitHub (98.4% multi-line, measured on a 103042-row sample; 27824 unique in sample). 0% overlap with every NL->bash corpus. This is by far the largest multi-line Bash source found - but it is code-only (a `language` column, no NL instruction), so it needs NL pairing before use.

Name: jragsdale1/ShIO-bash-26.1
Notes: NOT NL->bash. 4803184 rows of command -> (stdout, exit_code, env-state-delta) produced by ShIOEnv, a Gymnasium Bash env, over 86 Linux utilities on Ubuntu 24.04. 0.1% multi-line (measured on a 316245-row sample: 312736 unique commands). 0% overlap with every NL corpus. Directly relevant to our differential-validation step - it is off-the-shelf execution ground truth for real coreutils.

Name: Mitchins/NL-SHELL-MULTI
Notes: DERIVED/MERGE - not a new corpus. Documented aggregation of NL2Bash + tldr-pages + NL2SH-ALFA (train split). Confirmed by hashing: fully contains jiacheng-ye/nl2bash (7559) and TRamesh2/NL2CMD (8513). 63862 unique commands.

Name: AryaYT/nl2shell-training-v3
Notes: 12834 pairs (12799 unique). 8.0% multi-line. HEAVILY DERIVED: 59% of its commands are in NL2Bash and 65% in TRamesh2/NL2CMD; only ~35% appears novel. 961 rows flagged 'expert-curated'.

Name: AryaYT/nl2shell-terminal-bench
Notes: 7509 synthetic multi-step think -> command -> verify trajectories; each carries a verification command that checks success. Synthetic, not human-validated.

Name: Frost2o24/bash-instruct-55k
Notes: 55000 synthetic instruction-tuning rows. Companion set bash-instruct-II-55k has 54803. Provenance not documented - treat with caution.

Name: NickIBrody/linux-shell-corpus-ru-en
Notes: Bilingual Russian/English Linux shell assistant dataset. 25000 rows.

Name: mecha-org/linux-command-dataset
Notes: 8669 rows, 7500 unique commands, ~0% multi-line. Only 1-2% overlap with the canonical corpora.

Name: emirkaanozdemr/bash_command_data_6K
Notes: 6153 rows (4451 unique), 11.1% multi-line. ~1-3% overlap with canonical corpora.

Name: AnishJoshi/nl2bash-custom
Notes: 24569 non-empty rows, 12659 unique commands, 6.6% multi-line. HEAVILY DERIVED - measured 60% of its commands are in NL2Bash, 67% in TRamesh2/NL2CMD, 57% in NL2SH-ALFA. Roughly a third is novel.

Name: Edoigtrd/tldr-pages
Notes: 5274 rows extracted from the tldr-pages project (community-simplified man pages). 5012 unique commands. This is the raw tldr source that NL2SH-ALFA and NL-SHELL-MULTI both draw on - 30% of it is already inside NL2SH-ALFA.

Name: datasetter458/diverse-bash-dataset-extended
Notes: 9351 rows (8340 unique). Same author also has diverse-bash-dataset (4912), w3schools-bash-tutorial-QAs (417), bash-reference-manual-general-QAs (1276).

Name: huytd189/command-line-suggestions
Notes: 3334 rows, 2855 unique commands, ~1% overlap with canonical corpora.

Name: Euroswarms/bash
Notes: CAUTION - 1000000 rows advertised but only 4618 unique responses across a 483553-row sample, and the responses are fragments of the Bash reference manual ('${FUNCNAME[$i]}', 'job table (see Job Control Builtins)'). Low quality; do not count the headline number.

Name: missvector/linux-commands (LinLM)
Notes: 71775 rows but only 5451 UNIQUE commands - ~13x duplication inside the file. Re-uploaded verbatim 5 more times (see duplicates).

Name: AuricErgeson/text-to-shell-dataset
Notes: 697 rows, 492 unique.

Name: aelhalili/bash-commands-dataset
Notes: 840 rows, 472 unique. ~5-12% overlap with canonical corpora.

Name: byroneverson/shell-cmd-instruct
Notes: 500 rows, 377 unique.

Name: kth8/bash-toolcalls
Notes: 862 rows; bash commands framed as tool calls.

Name: epinnock/intercode-nl2bash-curated
Notes: 200 manually curated <query, gold> pairs reproducing the InterCode NL2Bash set. 60% of its commands are inside NL2SH-ALFA.

Name: ZygAI/zygai_linux_commands
Notes: 254 rows; bilingual Lithuanian/English.

Name: tmskss/linux-man-pages-tldr-summarized
Notes: 481 man pages summarized in tldr style.

Name: iselabvn/Linux-terminal-tool-calling
Notes: 600 rows; Linux terminal framed as tool calling.

Name: adeelahmad/bash-agent-grpo-pairs
Notes: 11745 rows, ALL unique, 46.2% multi-line - unusually high for an NL->cmd set. Read the `ground_truth` column, not `answer` (that one is wrapped in <think> reasoning). Measured 0% overlap with all canonical corpora. Synthetic, so quality is unvetted, but it is one of the few large sets with a real multi-line share.

Name: lisayan/rlvr-bash-terminal-bench
Notes: NOT a task set - 1120 model ROLLOUTS on Terminal-Bench tasks with reward / test_passed / test_failed / pass_rate recorded. Useful as difficulty labels, not as source data. Only 10.4% scored reward=1.0.

Name: CmdCaliper / CyPHER
Notes: EMNLP 2024 arXiv 2411.01176. NOT NL->bash: 28520 train + 2807 test pairs of SIMILAR COMMAND LINES (cmd <-> cmd) for security embedding models. Listed so we don't re-find it. github.com/cycraft-corp/CmdCaliper

Name: CodeSift (Bash split)
Notes: CONFIRMS the '???' in the existing row: 100 unique Bash tasks (x10 generations = 1000 task-code pairs), IBM Research, CLOUD 2024. No public release found - paper only. Used as a benchmark by ScriptSmith.

Name: harpomaxx/unix-commands
Notes: NOT NL->bash - do not add as a translation set. 100 rows of 'you are a Unix terminal, produce the OUTPUT' (command -> simulated terminal output). Same shape as mrheinen/linux-commands (481).
